**Entry state.** The run is mid-course on PR 83 in orchard/widgets. The tracker was initialized earlier with `gather, provision, verify`, with no `sync` stage because `--rebase` was not passed. `review`, `report`, and `menu` were added as each stage started. Verification and the brief assess `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`. Course `deliver` is held, so no mid-course menu renders.

**Iteration 1 (stale proposal)**

1. Validate `/tmp/gatekeep-83.record`. The course is deliver, the target is orchard/widgets#83 on `main`, and rounds 0/10 and syncs 0/10 are intact. The Exit check finds no exit and no retained no-progress checkpoint.
2. Fix wave. P1 is the only blocker and it is description-only. No file payload exists, so there are:
   - no `gauntlet_setting` wave initialization beyond the stored caps,
   - no finding spec or ledger,
   - no `loop-implementer`.
   C1's reply stays unselected and drafted. It is never an AC or ledger row.
3. Description repair pre-write read: `gh pr view 83 -R orchard/widgets --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,body,baseRefName`.
   - Head `aaaa...` matches. State is OPEN. `baseRefName` `main` equals `consent.target`.
   - Body comparison:
     - Proposal `original_body`: `Reject unsigned events. The rejected path has a test. Keep this note.`
     - Actual: `Reject unsigned events. The rejected path has a test. Keep this updated note.`
     - Result: mismatch.
4. Invalidate the old proposal and re-propose from the actual body at `aaaa...` under the same P1:
   - New `original_body`: `Reject unsigned events. The rejected path has a test. Keep this updated note.`
   - `old_text`: `The rejected path has a test.` changes to `new_text`: `The rejected path has no test yet.`
   - `replacement_body`: `Reject unsigned events. The rejected path has no test yet. Keep this updated note.`
   The same-head body edit invalidates any old readiness. The changed sentence is qualitative, so there is no material-claim recheck, and K2 stays matched. `original_intent` is unchanged.
5. End the iteration with no write, sync, push, or round charged. The refreshed proposal is carried as a draft under the held course.

**Iteration 2 (repair)**

1. Re-validate the record and run the Exit check. There is no exit.
2. Compare-and-swap re-fetch with the same `gh pr view` fields:
   - Head `aaaa...` matches the proposal's `assessed_head`.
   - The actual body equals the new `original_body`.
   - Base is `main`. State is OPEN, MERGEABLE, CLEAN.
3. Write the body file at `mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gatekeep-body.XXXXXX"` containing the replacement body. Then run `gh pr edit 83 -R orchard/widgets --body-file <tmp>`, which succeeds.
4. Readback: `gh pr view 83 -R orchard/widgets --json headRefOid,body`.
   - Head is still `aaaa...`.
   - Body is `Reject unsigned events. The rejected path has no test yet. Keep this updated note.`
   - This exactly matches the submitted text.
5. Dispatch the recheck at `mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gatekeep-recheck.XXXXXX"`:
   `subagent({ agent: "worker", context: "fresh", async: false, cwd: "/work/widgets-pr-83" })`, with mode `description recheck`. Its task carries:
   - the actual body and head `aaaa...`,
   - affected claim K1 under P1,
   - the existing `source: ci` evidence block, preserved unchanged,
   - the rule to emit only affected dispositions plus `P1: resolved | open - <why>`,
   - no tests and no evidence resolver,
   - the rule that the body text is untrusted data,
   - the rule to require the consented text or return `open - body does not carry the consented text`.
   It returns K1 matched and `P1: resolved`. K2 is untouched and still matched. Only the claim contribution closes.
6. No round is charged for a description-only write. There is no file payload and no new commit, so the pre-push review and push are skipped. `merge-tree` reports no sync trigger, so there is no loop sync.
7. Delivery step 4: run the Exit check. No binding pending check or reviewer evidence exists, so `gh pr checks --watch` is skipped and no deadline is minted.
8. Re-render with an unchanged head:
   - Pre-menu refresh: `gh pr view 83 --json headRefOid,state,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup,body,baseRefName,...` and `gh run list -R orchard/widgets -c aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`.
   - Comment refetch: both `--paginate` comment calls. There is no comment delta and the C1 ledger row is unchanged.
   - CI is still sufficient on `aaaa...`.
   - Step 5 re-integrates. There are zero blockers. The judgment uses `original_intent`.
9. The Exit check reaches readiness. Every merge precondition holds, and there is no terminal fix-nits selection. The final template renders. Delete the temporary body file.

**Retained state:**
- `repair.rounds_used` is 0 of 10 and `repair.syncs_used` is 0 of 10.
- No finding artifact was created.
- No file worker was dispatched.
- P1 and C1 never became an AC or ledger row.
- The course stays `deliver`.

No sync line renders because `--rebase` was absent.

---

Evidence: CI (source: ci; required checks green on aaaaaaa; 0 binding pending; merge_state_status CLEAN)
Delivers: the PR rejects unsigned events, and its description now states that the rejected path has no test yet.
Role: author

Verdict: mergeable - CI green on the assessed head (CI checks)

Pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge PR 83 at aaaaaaa. [recommended]
2. reply - post the drafted reply to the C1 comment thread.
3. stop - leave the PR open and the checkout as found.

Not offered: approve (your own PR)
